### Recent News {.unlisted}

- **July 2026** — A paper on the global exposure of stunted children to drought-sensitive ecosystems was published in *Environmental Research Letters*.
- **May 2026** — Presented research on heatstroke mortality in Japan under climate and demographic change at the EGU General Assembly 2026 in Vienna.

---

### About us {.unlisted}

Our lab develops Environmental Demodynamics, an emerging research field that integrates environmental and demographic change into a single analytical framework. We combine satellite-derived environmental information (vegetation, drought, flood, and heat exposure) with demographic data on migration, age structure, and health, using deep learning and spatial statistical models to reveal who moves, where, and how in response to environmental change — from local to global scales. Our goal is to translate these findings into better climate adaptation strategies and more reliable population projections.

### 研究室について {.unlisted}

本研究室は、環境変動と人口動態の相互作用を統合的に解明する新しい研究領域「環境人口動態学(Environmental Demodynamics)」を推進しています。衛星観測による環境情報(植生・干ばつ・洪水・熱波)と、人口移動・年齢構造・健康に関する人口統計を、深層学習や空間統計モデルによって結合し、「環境の変化が、誰を、どこへ、どのように動かすのか」を地域から全球までのスケールで実証的に明らかにします。得られた知見を、気候変動適応策や将来人口予測の高度化につなげることを目指しています。
